recovery.reason: The bounded worker retry ceiling was reached. The final worker candidate was hardened without another worker-model call before the Astra gate.

worker_preflight_evidence.result: 13 tests executed; one symlink fixture failed before recovery hardening
worker_preflight_evidence.note: No worker preflight PASS is claimed. Recovery validation is separate from worker evidence.

recovery_validation.note: Review #4 evidence gaps are corrected. Final PASS is not claimed until exact-head GitHub regression completes.

review_focus: concurrent/repeated worker execution claim using the exact production claim helper
exactly one logical model invocation for a shared dispatch binding
replay after dispatch success/controller receipt-write failure without another logical worker execution
conflicting receipt SHA and malformed claim binding fail closed before model/side effects
execute=false duplicate path performs no promotion, retry mutation, dispatch, or evidence upload
complete candidate artifact inventory and provenance including the production retry-flow script
existing immutable task binding, structured credential redaction, trusted-validator, retry recovery, staging safety, zero-spend/no-local-inference and no-auto-merge boundaries
known_limitations: Astra review and a separate merge/promotion gate remain required.
Repository policy can reject branch/ref pushes or PR creation; the controller fails closed rather than bypassing policy.
The controller and worker receipt mechanism creates small receipt refs under controller-dispatch-receipts/ and worker-execution-receipts/; lifecycle cleanup of those refs is not part of TASK-0002.

The worker job needs contents:write only to create the dispatch execution-receipt ref; checkout credentials are not persisted and GITHUB_TOKEN is passed only to the receipt-claim step, not to the Gemini worker process.
Raw failed logs are intentionally not persisted; failure evidence is limited to bounded structured job/failed-step metadata.

prior_candidate_ci.note: These runs were valid for head 625ba22 but Astra Review #4 required concurrent/repeated execution-claim coverage and corrected artifact inventory/provenance.

findings.issue: repository_dispatch retries could be attributed to a task derived from the moving default-branch workflow head instead of the immutable dispatched task
findings.correction: worker-context binds task_file/task_sha/task_id/retry_attempt/dispatch_key; worker and controller both verify that immutable binding

findings.issue: credential sanitization allowed fine-grained GitHub tokens and multiline/private-key payloads to survive
findings.correction: controller no longer persists raw failed logs; structured job/step diagnostics only, with stronger multiline/token/private-key sanitization

findings.issue: retry commit could be stranded when dispatch failed after push
findings.correction: retry commit stores PENDING_DISPATCH state; reprocessing discovers the same source-run marker and resumes the same immutable retry; controller and worker receipt refs deduplicate repeated delivery

findings.issue: worker staging could dereference symlinks before downstream bundle validation
findings.correction: worker validates manifest/candidate/metadata path components and regular-file types before any bundle copy; failed evidence does not copy arbitrary candidate files; controller validates promotion destinations

astra_review_02.required_resubmission: workflow-level tests for all four cases plus successful regressions tied to corrected exact head

findings: controller context downloaded inside checkout polluted strict retry mutation guard
candidate could replace helper before later promotion validation executed it
structured metadata sanitization missed block-scalar multiline credential payloads
failed-worker evidence copied unchecked worker_result metadata
valid execute=false context was treated as jq extraction failure
astra_review_03.correction_summary: Moved transient artifacts outside checkout; materialized immutable validators; redacted credential-bearing structured fields; removed raw failed-worker metadata; fixed boolean false handling; added production-path fixtures.

findings.issue: concurrent/repeated worker execution claim was not exercised through the production receipt-claim path
findings.correction: worker receipt claim moved into the immutable production helper and the production-path fixture now races two claimants, checks exactly one model marker, replays delivery, checks conflicting SHA, malformed binding, and execute=false side-effect gates

findings.issue: review packet/provenance omitted the production retry-flow script and stale validation counts
findings.correction: candidate artifact inventory now includes the retry-flow script; provenance records its creation; validation counts are 34 deterministic tests and 5 production-path fixtures

astra_review_04.required_resubmission: exact-head CI for the corrected branch plus truthful readiness evidence
